set -euo pipefail
python3 - <<'PY'
import pathlib, subprocess, socket, getpass, json, hashlib
assert getpass.getuser()=='ai-core-node'
assert socket.gethostname().startswith('ai-core-node')
p=pathlib.Path.home()/'omega-wt-needle-tasks'
def git(*args): return subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(p),*args],text=True).strip()
expected='0d2b1cd63c4e7c816386e72404fdef8cfa1e9a79'
assert git('rev-parse','HEAD')==expected, 'local HEAD changed'
assert git('branch','--show-current')=='needle-tasks'
assert not git('status','--porcelain'), 'worktree not clean'
for name, digest in [('PROTOCOL.md','b3ed91db1bd94e1f85931bb2ccc33fa3b75809c91b62775791f7ac2c126bd141'),('CHATGPT_SETUP_PROMPT.md','ce265eedda077e52e04d29a2a1780f05f7577cfa7ec037f42a38f5cdfd0459a9')]:
 assert hashlib.sha256((p/'needle-tasks'/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==digest
remote=git('remote','get-url','origin')
assert remote in ['https://github.com/gschaidergabriel/oMEGAcV1.git','https://github.com/gschaidergabriel/oMEGAcV1','git@github.com:gschaidergabriel/oMEGAcV1.git'], 'unexpected origin'
before=git('ls-remote','origin','refs/heads/main','refs/heads/needle-tasks','refs/heads/chatgpt-results')
refs=dict((line.split()[1],line.split()[0]) for line in before.splitlines())
for branch in ['needle-tasks','chatgpt-results']:
 assert refs.get('refs/heads/'+branch) in [None,expected], 'remote branch already diverged'
push=subprocess.run(['git','-C',str(p),'push','--atomic','origin',expected+':refs/heads/needle-tasks',expected+':refs/heads/chatgpt-results'],text=True,capture_output=True)
print(push.stdout)
print(push.stderr)
assert push.returncode==0, 'push failed'
after=git('ls-remote','origin','refs/heads/main','refs/heads/needle-tasks','refs/heads/chatgpt-results')
new=dict((line.split()[1],line.split()[0]) for line in after.splitlines())
assert new['refs/heads/needle-tasks']==expected and new['refs/heads/chatgpt-results']==expected
assert new.get('refs/heads/main')==refs.get('refs/heads/main'), 'main moved externally during publish'
print(json.dumps({'owner':'gabriel','machine_id':'ai-core-node','published_head':expected,'main_unchanged':True,'worktree_clean':not bool(git('status','--porcelain')),'refs':new}))
